reject_access_expired: Your access to this host has expired — ask the host's owner to grant it again.
reject_approval_timeout: Nobody approved the request on the host in time — approve this device in the host's web console, then request access again.
reject_bound_other: The host's pairing window is armed for a different device — arm it for this one.
reject_busy: The host is busy with another session.
reject_denied: The host declined this device's request.
reject_host_power: The host is going to sleep or shutting down — wake it when you want to play again.
reject_identity_required: The host requires pairing — pair this device (PIN or request access) first.
reject_launch_not_permitted: This device isn't permitted to launch games on the host — connect without picking a game, or ask the host's owner to allow launching.
reject_not_armed: Pairing isn't started on the host — start it on the Devices page of the host's web console, then try again.
reject_profile_locked: This profile is locked. Enter its password.
reject_profile_unknown: That profile is gone from this host. Pick another one.
reject_rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts — wait a couple of seconds and try again.
reject_seat_occupied: Someone is already playing as that profile.
reject_seat_unavailable: That profile can't play on this host right now.
reject_setup_failed: The host accepted the connection but couldn't start the stream — the host's log (web console → Diagnostics → Logs) has the cause.
reject_superseded: A newer request from this device replaced this one — approve the latest request on the host.
reject_wire_version: Client and host versions don't match — update both to the same release.
apierr_account_at_desk: {account} is signed in at the host itself. Try again once they have signed out.
apierr_account_is_administrator: {account} is an administrator. A seat is a standard user: make {account} a standard user in Windows, or pick another account.
apierr_account_is_owner: {account} is this host's owner, who has a profile of their own.
apierr_account_locked: {account}'s account is locked or has expired.
apierr_account_locked_windows: Windows locked {account} out after too many wrong passwords. Wait ten minutes.
apierr_account_missing: There is no account called {account} on this host.
apierr_account_missing_windows: No Windows account {account} on this host.
apierr_account_name_lowercase: Enter the account's Linux user name, in lowercase.
apierr_account_network_denied: Couldn't check {account}'s password — this host's policy denies it sign-in from the network. In Local Security Policy, remove it from Deny access to this computer from the network, then try again.
apierr_account_not_ordinary: {account} is a system account, not a person's.
apierr_account_policy: {account} isn't allowed to sign in over Remote Desktop on this host.
apierr_account_signed_in: {account} is signed in on this host. Sign {account} out first.
apierr_credential_changed: {account}'s Windows password changed or expired. Enter the new one on the profile's card.
apierr_credential_invalid_control_char: The password can't hold a tab or a line break.
apierr_credential_invalid_no_password: This account has no password. Set one in Windows first.
apierr_credential_must_change: {account}'s password has expired. Choose a new one at the host itself, then try again.
apierr_credential_must_change_windows: Windows wants {account}'s password changed. Sign in to {account} at the host once and set it, then enter the new one here.
apierr_credential_must_change_windows_ma: Windows wants {account}'s password changed. Remove the profile, sign in to {account} at the host and set the new password, then add the profile again.
apierr_device_access_expired: This device's access to the host has expired — ask the host's owner to grant it again.
apierr_device_admit_internet: Couldn't admit this device: it knocked from the internet, where the name it sent proves nothing. Arm a PIN bound to its fingerprint instead, then read the PIN out to whoever is holding it.
apierr_device_admit_relayed: Couldn't admit this device: it came through the web client, where the name it sent proves nothing. Arm a PIN bound to its fingerprint instead, then read the PIN out to whoever is holding it.
apierr_device_admit_unfamiliar_origin: Couldn't admit this device: it asked from a page this host doesn't know. Pair it with a PIN instead.
apierr_device_display_not_cleared: Couldn't clear the display settings for this device
apierr_device_display_not_saved: Couldn't save the display settings for this device
apierr_device_not_allowed_host_power: This device's access doesn't include host power — ask the host's owner to turn on the Host power grant
apierr_device_not_allowed_to_manage_game: This device isn't allowed to manage games on this host.
apierr_device_not_allowed_to_start_games: This device isn't allowed to start games on this host.
apierr_device_not_allowed_to_wake_seat: This device isn't allowed to start another profile's seat.
apierr_devices_full: This profile has too many signed-in devices. Sign one out in the web console, then try again.
apierr_display_next_fixed_by_settings: The host's settings file fixes which monitor is streamed.
apierr_display_next_no_other_monitor: The host has no other monitor to stream.
apierr_display_next_not_streaming: Only the device that is streaming can switch the monitor.
apierr_display_next_unsupported: Switching the streamed monitor needs a Linux or Windows host.
apierr_display_next_virtual: The host streams a virtual display, not one of its monitors.
apierr_door_account_name: This account's name can't be switched automatically.
apierr_door_account_not_switchable: This account can't be switched automatically.
apierr_door_deck_stale: This Deck's seats are on an older build than its host. Run bash ~/punktfunk/scripts/steamdeck/update.sh in Konsole and enter your password, then turn this on.
apierr_door_linux_only: Reachable without logging in is a Linux setting.
apierr_door_missing_build: This build doesn't include it. Install Punktfunk from a package to use it.
apierr_door_missing_nix: Turn it on in your NixOS configuration with services.punktfunk.seats.enable = true, then rebuild.
apierr_door_missing_package: This install is missing the punktfunk-seats package. Install it: {command}
apierr_door_missing_package_rpm_ostree: This install is missing the punktfunk-seats package. Update Punktfunk, then restart: sudo /usr/share/punktfunk/update-punktfunk.sh
apierr_door_missing_steamos: This Deck hasn't set it up yet. Run bash ~/punktfunk/scripts/steamdeck/update.sh in Konsole and enter your password.
apierr_door_missing_sysext: This image doesn't include it yet. Update Punktfunk: sudo punktfunk-sysext update
apierr_door_no_owner: This host has no owner's host to answer that. Turn Reachable without logging in off and on again.
apierr_door_no_owner_account: This host has no owner to hand its files back to.
apierr_door_not_in_update_group: Add {user} to the punktfunk-update group first: sudo usermod -aG punktfunk-update {user}
apierr_door_own_user_unknown: Couldn't tell which account this host runs as.
apierr_door_switch_failed: Couldn't start the switch. Check the host log.
apierr_door_switch_not_allowed: This account isn't allowed to switch it. Add it to the punktfunk-update group, then try again.
apierr_door_switch_not_started: Couldn't start the switch. Check that systemd is running.
apierr_door_update_group_restart: Restart the host to finish adding {user} to the punktfunk-update group. Punktfunk started before it.
apierr_driver_install: Windows couldn't install the seat display driver.
apierr_driver_missing: The seat display driver isn't installed on this host. Reinstall Punktfunk, then try again.

apierr_host_power_busy_other_device: Another device is streaming from this host, or a seat that isn't answering might be. Try again in a moment.
apierr_host_power_needs_authorization: The host would need interactive authorization — is the host user in group 'punktfunk' (and no second local user logged in)?

apierr_host_restart_no_service: The host isn't running as the Punktfunk service, so nothing would start it again
apierr_host_restart_no_user_service: The host isn't running as its user service, so nothing would start it again

apierr_player_number_too_high: That player number is higher than this host has controllers for.

close_display_asleep: The host's screen is asleep and couldn't be woken. Wake it, then connect again.
close_join_needs_10bit: Couldn't join the shared screen — it streams in 10-bit color, and this device can't. Connect this device first and let the other one join it.
close_join_needs_444: Couldn't join the shared screen — it streams in full color detail (4:4:4), and this device can't. Connect this device first and let the other one join it.
close_join_needs_hdr: Couldn't join the shared screen — it's in HDR, and this device isn't streaming in HDR. Turn on HDR in this app's settings, or ask whoever connected first to turn it off.
close_join_other_codec: Couldn't join the shared screen — this device streams with a video codec that can't share it. Set the same video codec on both devices, then join again.
close_join_range: Couldn't join the shared screen — its color range is one this device can't show. Connect this device first and let the other one join it.
close_monitor_missing: The host is set to stream “{monitor}”, which isn't connected. Pick another screen in its web console, under Displays.
close_monitor_none: The host is set to capture a monitor called "{monitor}", and reports no monitors at all. Clear that in the host's display settings to stream a virtual display instead.
close_niri_no_outputs: The host's niri can't create a display for this stream. Its owner can install biri; the web console shows how.
close_path_changed: The network path changed and this stream can't be resized.
close_path_too_small: This network path can't carry the stream at its packet size.
close_profile_removed: Your profile was removed by the host's owner.
close_umbriel_mismatch: The host can't talk to this version of Umbriel. Update Punktfunk on the host.
close_umbriel_no_capture: This Umbriel session can't be captured directly; the stream needs a GPU encoder.
close_unlock_from_browser: Open this profile from the Punktfunk app.
close_unlock_not_started: This profile's desktop didn't start. Try again in a moment.
close_unlock_silent: This host's seat service didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
close_unlock_unreadable: Couldn't read the password this device sent. Try again.
close_unlock_update_app: This profile needs its account password. Update Punktfunk on this device.
diag_encoder_sharing_impact: {sessions} shares the encoder with the stream, so stream frames wait behind its frames and the picture stutters.
diag_encoder_sharing_na_not_nvidia: Only NVIDIA GPUs report who uses the video encoder.
diag_encoder_sharing_ok_summary: No other app is using the video encoder right now.
diag_encoder_sharing_remedy: Close or pause the other recorder (NVIDIA Instant Replay, OBS, Discord) while you stream. On Windows, Pause Instant Replay in the host settings handles Instant Replay by itself.
diag_encoder_sharing_summary: Another app is using the video encoder
diag_group_predates_remedy: Restart the host. The membership is already recorded, but Punktfunk's services started before it and keep their old groups until a restart — logging out isn't enough.
diag_group_predates_summary: The group “{group}” was granted but this session predates it
diag_hyprland_permissions_impact: Hyprland silently denies screencopy and virtual input: the client sees black frames and input does nothing. If streaming already works, nothing needs doing.
diag_hyprland_permissions_na_no_session: This host isn't running a Hyprland session, so Hyprland's permission system doesn't apply.
diag_hyprland_permissions_na_not_linux: Hyprland's permission system is a Linux feature.
diag_hyprland_permissions_ok_summary: Hyprland is not enforcing per-application permissions, so nothing needs granting.
diag_hyprland_permissions_remedy: Grant this host screencopy and virtual input in your Hyprland config, then reload it: in hyprland.lua on Hyprland 4.x and Omarchy, as “permission = …” lines on hyprlang.
diag_hyprland_permissions_summary: Hyprland is enforcing permissions and this host may not be granted
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_impact: Every connect fails: this niri can't create a display for the stream. Pinning a physical monitor in the web console streams that monitor instead.
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_na_no_session: This host isn't running a niri session, so niri's virtual outputs don't apply.
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_ok_summary: niri can create a virtual display for each stream.
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_pinned_impact: The monitor pinned in the web console still streams. Without the pin, every connect fails: this niri can't create a display for the stream.
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_remedy: Install biri, the niri fork that adds virtual outputs: on Arch the AUR package “biri-git” replaces “niri”. Log in again, then restart the host. See {url}
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_silent_impact: Until niri answers, a stream may get no display of its own. ({error})
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_silent_summary: niri didn't answer the virtual display check
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_summary: This niri can't create virtual displays
diag_pad_audio_missing_impact: Games see no DualSense speaker, so haptics fall back to rumble. The host retries at the next connect.
diag_pad_audio_missing_summary: The controller speaker endpoint is not set up
diag_pad_audio_na_off: Controller audio is turned off on this host.
diag_pad_audio_na_windows_only: The controller speaker endpoint is a Windows component.

match.n=one: The controller speaker endpoint takes the host's open ({count} controller slot).
match.n=other: The controller speaker endpoint takes the host's open ({count} controller slots).

diag_pad_audio_refused_impact: Games can't pair the DualSense with its speaker, so haptics fall back to rumble and the controller stays silent.
diag_pad_audio_refused_remedy: Update Steam — its streaming audio driver backs the endpoint — and restart the Punktfunk host. If it stays, run “punktfunk-host pad-endpoint repair” as administrator.
diag_pad_audio_refused_summary: The controller speaker endpoint refuses the 4-channel format
diag_pad_driver_identity_impact: Games see a different controller than the player picked, so buttons and prompts can be wrong.
diag_pad_driver_identity_summary: A virtual controller showed up as {got}, not {want}
diag_pad_driver_na_windows_only: The virtual controller driver is a Windows component.
diag_pad_driver_ok_summary: The virtual controller driver matches this host.
diag_pad_driver_ok_unseen_summary: No controller has connected since the host started.
diag_pad_driver_protocol_impact: Games see the controller, but it never moves: the driver refuses the host.
diag_pad_driver_protocol_summary: The virtual controller driver speaks protocol {driver_protocol}; this host needs {host_protocol}
diag_pad_driver_remedy: Reinstall the host (the installer bundles the matching controller drivers), then reconnect the controller.
diag_pad_driver_stale_impact: Controllers work, but with the old driver's bugs.
diag_pad_driver_stale_summary: The virtual controller driver is revision {driver_rev}; this host needs {host_rev}
diag_pad_driver_unattached_impact: Games get no input from that controller.
diag_pad_driver_unattached_summary: No driver picked up the last virtual controller
diag_plugin_sandbox_bwrap_refused_impact: The plugin runner stops instead of running a plugin unsandboxed, so the game library stays empty: bubblewrap refused the sandbox — {error}
diag_plugin_sandbox_bwrap_refused_remedy: Allow unprivileged user namespaces and use bubblewrap 0.8 or newer, then start the plugin runner again.
diag_plugin_sandbox_door_summary: The door runs no plugins. The owner's host runs them.
diag_plugin_sandbox_na_no_runner: There is no plugin runner on this host.
diag_plugin_sandbox_na_not_installed: The plugin runner is not installed on this host.
diag_plugin_sandbox_no_bwrap_impact: The plugin runner stops instead of running a plugin unsandboxed, so the game library stays empty: bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed
diag_plugin_sandbox_no_bwrap_remedy: Install bubblewrap (bwrap) with your package manager, then start the plugin runner again.
diag_plugin_sandbox_off_impact: Every installed plugin runs with your account's access: your files, your session, and the host's own credentials.
diag_plugin_sandbox_off_remedy: Remove PUNKTFUNK_PLUGIN_SANDBOX from the plugin runner's override, then restart it.
diag_plugin_sandbox_off_windows_impact: Every installed plugin runs with the plugin runner's whole access: each other's files, the launchers' folders, and the loopback management port.
diag_plugin_sandbox_off_windows_remedy: Remove PUNKTFUNK_PLUGIN_SANDBOX from host.env, then restart the host.
diag_plugin_sandbox_ok_summary: Each plugin runs in its own sandbox.
diag_plugin_sandbox_ok_windows_summary: Each plugin runs in its own AppContainer.
diag_plugin_sandbox_stopped_error_impact: It couldn't build a plugin sandbox when it started, so no plugin runs and the game library stays empty: {error}
diag_plugin_sandbox_stopped_impact: It couldn't build a plugin sandbox when it started, so no plugin runs and the game library stays empty
diag_plugin_sandbox_stopped_remedy: Repair what it names, then start the plugin runner again.
diag_restart_pending_impact: Until then the host runs with the values it started with.
diag_restart_pending_ok_summary: Every host setting is in effect.
diag_restart_pending_remedy: Restart it from Host → Settings in the web console.
diag_server_conflict_impact: Both servers bind the same ports, so whichever won the bind answers — pairing and connections can land on the other server while this host looks installed and healthy.
diag_server_conflict_ok_summary: No other game-streaming server is active on this host.
diag_server_conflict_remedy: Stop the other server (and disable it if it starts on its own), then restart this host.
diag_takeover_privilege_impact: Streams that need the managed takeover can't stop {dm}, so they mirror the host's own session instead — a black screen when its monitor is off.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_no_dm: No display manager drives this host's logins, so a takeover has nothing to stop.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_no_session: This host has no gamescope session infrastructure, so the managed takeover never runs here.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_not_linux: The managed gamescope takeover is a Linux feature.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_root: The host runs as root, so it stops the display manager directly and never needs the privilege helper.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_unknown_user: The host's user name couldn't be resolved, so no group membership could be checked.
diag_takeover_privilege_na_unpackaged: This is an unpackaged install: it has no privilege helper and no group, and uses the polkit rule from the documentation instead.
diag_takeover_privilege_remedy: Add the user to the “{group}” group, then restart the host. That group can also create virtual USB devices, so use it only on a host you trust.
diag_takeover_privilege_summary: User “{user}” is not in the “{group}” group
diag_uinput_access_denied_impact: Every virtual controller fails to be created, so games see no controller at all — and the pen and tablet input paths are dead with it.
diag_uinput_access_error_impact: Virtual controllers may fail to be created, so games can see no controller.
diag_uinput_access_error_remedy: Check the state of {path} on this host.
diag_uinput_access_missing_impact: Every virtual controller fails to be created, so games see no controller at all.
diag_uinput_access_missing_remedy: Load the kernel module that provides {path} and install the udev rule that grants the “input” group access to it (scripts/60-punktfunk.rules — the packages install both).
diag_uinput_access_na_platform: Virtual controllers are created through this platform's own driver stack rather than uinput.
diag_uinput_access_ok_summary: The input device nodes are reachable.
diag_uinput_access_remedy: Add the user to the “input” group, then restart the host. If the group already lists the user, the udev rule granting it access may be missing (scripts/60-punktfunk.rules).
diag_uinput_access_ublue_remedy: Add the user to the “input” group with ujust, then restart the host. On this system a plain “usermod” doesn't last.
diag_vdisplay_driver_absent_impact: No virtual monitor can be created, so every stream is a black screen.
diag_vdisplay_driver_absent_summary: The virtual display driver is not installed
diag_vdisplay_driver_installed_summary: The virtual display driver is installed. It starts with the next stream.
diag_vdisplay_driver_na_windows_only: The virtual display driver is a Windows component.
diag_vdisplay_driver_not_ready_impact: The host retries on every connect, so this may be a driver still starting up. If it stays, streams have no video. ({error})
diag_vdisplay_driver_not_ready_remedy: Wait a moment and refresh. If it stays, check the punktfunk Virtual Display adapter in Device Manager, or reboot.
diag_vdisplay_driver_not_ready_summary: The virtual display driver did not open
diag_vdisplay_driver_outdated_impact: The host refuses a mismatched driver, so no virtual monitor can be created.
diag_vdisplay_driver_outdated_summary: The virtual display driver speaks protocol {driver_protocol}; this host needs {host_protocol}
diag_vdisplay_driver_remedy: Reinstall the host — the installer bundles the matching driver.
diag_vdisplay_driver_wedged_impact: Every stream connects with audio and a black screen: the host can't create its virtual monitor, so no video is ever captured, and the stuck sessions keep the host reporting busy.
diag_vdisplay_driver_wedged_remedy: Restart Punktfunk. If it happens again, disable and re-enable the punktfunk Virtual Display adapter in Device Manager; RivaTuner Statistics Server is a known cause, so close it first.
diag_vdisplay_driver_wedged_summary: The virtual display driver is not answering
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_na_not_linux: USB/IP controllers are a Linux feature.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_no_module_remedy: Load the vhci_hcd module (the packages install a modules-load rule that does this at boot; on an unpackaged install, load it by hand).
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_no_module_summary: The vhci_hcd kernel module is not loaded
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_node_group_remedy: Install the udev rule that grants the “{group}” group access to the vhci nodes (scripts/60-punktfunk.rules — the packages install it), then reload the rules or reboot.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_node_group_summar: The vhci attach node is not owned by the expected group
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_not_member_remedy: Add the user to the “{group}” group, then restart the host. That group can create virtual USB devices, so use it only on a host you trust.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_not_member_summar: User “{user}” is not in the “{group}” group
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_pads_impact: USB/IP controllers can't attach, so Steam Input sees no virtual Steam Deck or Steam Controller: Game Mode can't be driven with a controller, and Switch 2 controllers fall back to the Switch Pro.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_switch2_impact: Switch 2 controllers fall back to the Switch Pro. USB/IP is off for Steam and DualSense controllers, so nothing else changes.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_unwritable_remedy: Check that the host's user is in the “{group}” group and that the udev rule granting it access to the vhci nodes is installed, then restart the host.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_unwritable_summar: The USB/IP controllers' attach node isn't writable
hostupdate_helper_not_authorized: Not authorized to start the update helper — enable web-triggered updates first
hostupdate_pacman_not_opted_in: Pacman full-sysupgrade isn't opted in — set PACMAN_FULL_SYSUPGRADE=1 in {path} (this runs “pacman -Syu” for the whole system)
hostupdate_rolled_back: The host restarted still running {from} (expected {to}) — the installer aborted or rolled back; see its log
launch_adopted: {title} was already running from an earlier session — this picked that copy up instead of starting a second one.
launch_adopted_unknown: {title} was started a moment ago, so this picked that launch up rather than starting a second copy. Start it again if nothing comes up.
launch_closed_at_once: Couldn't start {title} — it closed again after {seconds} s.
launch_command_missing: Couldn't start {title} — this host doesn't have that command.
launch_command_not_runnable: Couldn't start {title} — this host can't run that command.
launch_download_no_answer: Couldn't download {title} — the plugin that lists it didn't answer.
launch_download_paused: {title}'s download was paused. Start it again to resume.
launch_download_stalled: {title} stopped downloading. Start it again to try once more.
launch_nothing_to_run: Couldn't start {title} — this host had nothing to run for it.
launch_shared_screen: Couldn't start that game — this screen is shared, and the first device to connect picks the game.
launch_title_not_in_library: Couldn't start that game — it isn't in this host's library anymore.
launch_title_not_on_desktop: Couldn't start that game — this desktop doesn't have its emulator, launcher or game files.
seatcheck_account_administrator: Its Windows account {account} is an administrator, which a seat must not be. Remove it from Administrators.
seatcheck_account_gone: Its Windows account {account} is gone, or was made again. Remove the profile and add it again.
seatcheck_account_group: Its Windows account {account} left the {group} group. It's put back when the seat next starts.
seatcheck_account_not_ours: Its Windows account {account} is missing or isn't Punktfunk's. Remove the profile and add it again.
seatcheck_account_password_lost: Punktfunk has lost the password of its Windows account {account}. Remove the profile and add it again.
seatcheck_account_password_lost_adopted: Punktfunk has lost {account}'s password. Enter it again on the profile's card.
seatcheck_account_rights: Its Windows account {account} lost a right it needs to sign in to its seat. Remove the profile and add it again.
seatcheck_account_set_up: Its Windows account {account} is set up.
seatcheck_account_set_up_adopted: Its Windows account {account} is set up. While it's a seat, nobody signs in to it at the host itself.
seatcheck_architecture_unknown: Couldn't tell whether this host is x64 — {error}. Seats need an x64 host.
seatcheck_box_identity_missing: The host has no identity yet; start Punktfunk once.
seatcheck_box_pin_changed: The host's certificate no longer matches {path}, so every face or fingerprint unlock is refused. Once the change is known to be the host's own, remove that file.
seatcheck_box_pin_ok: The host's certificate matches the pin key proofs use.
seatcheck_child_state_stopped: Stopped. It starts when its player connects.
seatcheck_compositor_missing: Neither kwin_wayland nor gamescope is installed.
seatcheck_device_list: The profile's device list couldn't be read, so no device is signed in: {error}
seatcheck_door_group_missing: The punktfunk-door group doesn't exist; reinstall the package that creates it.
seatcheck_edition_unknown: Couldn't tell which edition of Windows this is.
seatcheck_gpu_missing: No graphics card was found. Seats need a GPU.
seatcheck_host_executable: A Punktfunk file is missing ({path}). Reinstall Punktfunk.
seatcheck_identity: Punktfunk's service isn't running as Local System. Reinstall Punktfunk.
seatcheck_logind_missing: systemd-logind isn't running, so a seat can't get a session.
seatcheck_probe: Couldn't read this host's Remote Desktop and graphics settings.
seatcheck_rdp_network: A firewall rule lets other computers reach Remote Desktop, which seats keep to this host. Turn that rule off in Windows Firewall, or allow Remote Desktop from the network under Profiles → Seats.
seatcheck_rdp_pin_missing: Remote Desktop's certificate isn't recorded, so seats can't sign in. Turn seats off and on under Profiles → Seats.

match.n=one: Remote Desktop runs {count} more day without a license server.
match.n=other: Remote Desktop runs {count} more days without a license server.

match.n=one: Remote Desktop runs {count} more day without a license server. After that seats can't sign in: set one up with CALs.
match.n=other: Remote Desktop runs {count} more days without a license server. After that seats can't sign in: set one up with CALs.

seatcheck_rds_grace_over: Remote Desktop's days without a license server are over, so seats can't sign in. Set up a license server with CALs.
seatcheck_rds_grace_server: Remote Desktop gets its licenses from a license server.
seatcheck_rds_grace_unread: Couldn't read how long Remote Desktop runs without a license server. Run the check again in a few minutes.
seatcheck_rds_licensing_missing: Remote Desktop licensing isn't set. Press Set up Remote Desktop in Profiles → Seats to set it to Per User.
seatcheck_rds_licensing_set: Remote Desktop licensing is now Per User.
seatcheck_rds_role_installed: Remote Desktop Session Host is now installed.
seatcheck_rds_role_missing: Remote Desktop Session Host isn't installed. Press Set up Remote Desktop in Profiles → Seats to install it; Windows then needs a restart.
seatcheck_rds_role_ok: Remote Desktop Session Host is installed.
seatcheck_rds_role_unknown: Couldn't confirm that Remote Desktop Session Host is installed. If it isn't, press Set up Remote Desktop in Profiles → Seats.
seatcheck_rds_setup: Windows couldn't set up Remote Desktop. Add Remote Desktop Session Host under Remote Desktop Services in Server Manager, restart, then try again.
seatcheck_render_group_missing: The render group doesn't exist, so a seat can't use the graphics card.
seatcheck_render_node_missing: No graphics card render node was found, so seats can't stream.
seatcheck_render_node_ok: A GPU render node is present
seatcheck_reservation_off: Seats are off. Turn them on under Profiles → Seats.
seatcheck_restart: Remote Desktop Session Host is installed. Restart the host, then press Set up Remote Desktop again to finish.
seatcheck_seat_audio: Seats stream without sound: Steam's streaming audio driver isn't on this host. Install Steam, then restart the seats.
seatcheck_seat_display_driver_missing: The seat display driver isn't installed. Seats put it back when they next start; if this stays, turn seats off and on under Profiles → Seats.
seatcheck_seat_display_driver_ok: The seat display driver is installed.
seatcheck_seat_display_driver_outdated: The seat display driver is older than this Punktfunk. Seats update it when they next start.
seatcheck_seat_display_driver_unstaged: The seat display driver isn't installed on this host. Reinstall Punktfunk.
seatcheck_seat_display_rank: Windows' own Remote Desktop display driver is newer than Punktfunk's, so seats start without a picture. Update Punktfunk.
seatcheck_seat_port_closed: It's running, but its ports {native_port} and {mgmt_port} aren't both open. Stop and start the seat.
seatcheck_seat_port_taken: Another program holds its port {port}, so the seat can't start. Restart the host.
seatcheck_seat_resources: Its display slot and ports don't match ({slot}, {native_port}, {mgmt_port}). Remove the profile and add it again.
seatcheck_seat_unit_missing: The seat unit or its scripts are missing; reinstall the host package.
seatcheck_seat_unit_ok: The seat unit and its scripts are installed
seatcheck_session_provider_desktop: This edition of Windows runs one desktop at a time, so seats can't start. Seats need Windows Server.
seatcheck_session_provider_server: Windows Server gives each seat a desktop of its own.
seatcheck_session_provider_wrapper: A Remote Desktop wrapper gives each seat a desktop on this edition of Windows. Only Windows Server is supported.
seatcheck_steam_client_none: No Steam: the host has none to copy.
seatcheck_steam_client_ok: Has its own Steam. Steam opened on this seat starts that copy.
seatcheck_steam_client_pending: Its own Steam isn't set up yet. It's copied the first time the seat starts; Steam games start on the seat once that's done.
seatcheck_steam_elsewhere: Steam is installed in {path}, so seats get no Steam. Seats copy Steam only from C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam; reinstall it there.
seatcheck_steam_installed: Steam is installed in {path}. Each seat gets a copy of its own.
seatcheck_steam_libraries_unreachable: Its Steam can't open the host's game libraries, so their games are missing here. Restart the seat, and report a bug if they're still missing.
seatcheck_steam_none: Steam isn't installed, so seats have no Steam.
seatcheck_steam_sandboxed: Its Steam is a Flatpak or Snap app, which doesn't see the host's game libraries, so their games are missing here. Install the distribution's Steam package on the host to share them.
seatcheck_systemd_missing: This host doesn't run systemd, which seats need.
seatcheck_termservice_off: Remote Desktop Services isn't running. Start it under Services, or restart the host.
seatcheck_tools_ok: The account and ACL tools are installed
seatcheck_windows_build_ok: This Windows is new enough for seats (build {build}).
seatcheck_windows_build_old: This Windows is too old for seats (build {build}). Seats need Windows Server 2025 or newer.
seatcheck_windows_server_desktop: Playing at the same time needs Windows Server — this is a desktop edition of Windows. To take turns, add an Own account profile instead.
seatcheck_windows_server_wrapper: A Remote Desktop wrapper lets this desktop edition of Windows run concurrent seats. Only Windows Server is supported for that. To take turns instead, add an Own account profile.
seatline_account_not_startable: This profile signs in to an account this host can't start yet.
seatline_host_failed: Punktfunk didn't start on the seat. The seat's log has the cause.
seatline_no_owner_seat: This host has no seat for the owner yet.
seatline_pc_occupied: Someone else is playing on this host right now.
seatline_screen_failed: The seat's screen didn't start. The graphics card or the seat display driver failed its check.
seatline_seat_gone: This profile's seat is gone. Remove the profile and add it again.
seatline_seat_service_silent: The host's seat service isn't answering.
seatline_seats_off: This host needs seats turned on for a second profile.
seatline_sign_in_once: Sign {profile} in at the host once.
seatline_signin_failed: Windows didn't sign in to the seat's account. Remote Desktop may be off or out of licenses.
seatline_single_session: This Windows edition serves one person at a time.
seatline_stage_display: Checking the seat's screen and graphics card…
seatline_stage_display_try: Checking the seat's screen and graphics card (try {attempt} of {total})…
seatline_stage_host_try: Starting Punktfunk on the seat (try {attempt} of {total})…
seatline_stage_sign_in: Signing in to the seat's Windows account…
seatline_stage_sign_in_try: Signing in to the seat's Windows account (try {attempt} of {total})…
seatline_timeout_display: The seat didn't start in time. It stopped while checking the seat's screen and graphics card.
seatline_timeout_host: The seat didn't start in time. It stopped while starting Punktfunk on the seat.
seatline_timeout_sign_in: The seat didn't start in time. It stopped while signing in to the seat's Windows account.
